summary: Tenant isolation as the product itself guards it: its tenant-SQL check, which fails on any new query over a tenant table that neither filters by organisation nor says how it is scoped. (Its per-tool isolation sweep runs in the functional lane's smoke row, which it ends.)
not_covered: Row-level security: the product scopes rows in its queries, not with database policies (datastores.postgres.rls is "off"). Proving row-level security on every deploy is ticket mold_v0-031.
Queries the product's baseline file lists as pending review (scripts/tenant-sql-baseline.json) are reported by the product's own check, not failed.

checks.name: check:tenant-sql

requires.else: Install the product's own dependencies into the snapshot's ignored folders (no lockfile is written there): npm --prefix molds/mold_v0/codebase ci && npm --prefix molds/mold_v0/codebase/orchestrator ci && npm --prefix molds/mold_v0/codebase/web install --no-package-lock

checks.why: The product's own `npm run check:tenant-sql`: a query over a tenant table with no organisation filter and no scoping note.
